name: bird_hoot_cheer
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this Hoot reference into one production key frame. Keep exactly the same pale tawny cream round owl, heart-shaped white facial disc, amber eyes, grey-brown speckled wings, tiny star-patterned blue nightcap, NO ear tufts. Preserve the same square canvas, BODY SCALE and torso location, camera, feather texture and warm upper-left lighting. Joyful cheer: exactly TWO wings raised high in a celebratory V, open mouth smiling, both orange feet planted on the idle baseline. Whole bird safely within canvas, never scale body down to fit wings. Transparent alpha background, single bird, no floor, shadow, border, text or decorations.
